text:
mae: FYI found a flaky dup in the onboarding sample that only shows up when a 429 hits during token refresh + stream resume. repro in thread.

mae: Repro (minimal):
1) client opens streaming POST to /v1/streams/chat with Authorization header.
2) token TTL elapses mid-stream, server returns 429 on the next chunk.
3) SDK refreshes token and immediately re-sends the chunk envelope (same body).
4) Server accepts both envelopes within dedupe window -> duplicate side-effect.

tara: ugh. is this the SDK that short-circuits backoff when it sees an auth-refresh?

mae: yes. We special-case refresh path to avoid waiting, so it does an immediate retry. also we don't attach any idempotency header by default for streaming chunk frames.

yusuf: two quick mitigations: (A) SDK: add a small randomized delay on refresh retry (full jitter) and (B) app-level: attach an operation-level id for each logical mutation so the server can dedupe.

yusuf: suggested backoff: base=250ms; sleep = Math.random() * Math.min(base * 2**attempt, 10000) // full jitter, cap 10s

mae: I like that. For streaming, operation-level id needs to be stable across retries (not per-frame uuid). propose header `X-RW-Operation-Id: <uuid>` on the initial request and include it in resumed chunk replays.

tara: server-side note: we already have a short in-memory processed set used by webhooks. We could mirror that behavior for streams: keep seen operation ids for 60s and return 409 if duplicate seen recently. That keeps runtime small and predictable.

mae: edge case: some customers want at-most-once for long-running flows >60s. we should document TTL and allow server to accept an optional `Idempotency-Expiry` header (seconds) so clients can request the window length. server will clamp to a max.

yusuf: parity concern: Java & Python SDKs implement retry/internals differently. need consistent behavior on: default idempotency header for mutating endpoints, refresh-path jitter, and a hook to supply operation id for streams.

mae: sampleapp quick patch idea: attach `X-RW-Operation-Id` on the `start_stream` call and for mid-stream chunk retries keep the same id. snippet to add in sampleapp client:
```
const opId = uuidv4();
fetch('/v1/streams/chat', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, 'X-RW-Operation-Id': opId } })
// on retry of a chunk, include opId in the envelope
```

tara: qa suggestion: add a harness that forces token expiry mid-stream and simulates a 429 on the next write, assert server observed 1 side-effect. short, deterministic test.

qa-bot: opened RW-4001: "devex: streaming retry dupe during refresh - sampleapp & SDK parity" assigned to @yusuf. steps to repro attached.

yusuf: I'll start a small SDK PR to: 1) enable refresh-path full jitter by default, 2) add pluggable idempotency header config, and 3) expose a `setOperationId()` helper for streaming clients.

mae: can we also expose a diagnostic header on the response `X-RW-Dedupe-Result: accepted|duplicate|expired` so clients can log when they hit a dup? useful for support.

tara: +1. helps debugging without requiring server logs. we should make it opt-in behind a feature flag.

deploy-bot: note: any SDK change touching auth/retry needs a canary and test matrix across python/node/java. schedule: canary slot 03:00 UTC tomorrow.

mae: action items:
- yusuf: PR for jitter + idempotency config (will include unit tests)
- tara: add sampleapp harness + test that simulates token expiry mid-stream
- mae: onboarding doc update documenting Operation-Id header and server dedupe window

yusuf: will post PR link when ready and add cross-language checklist. ping me if anyone wants to pair on the replay-harness. :mag:
